standings.note: Descriptive FBS records including postseason; conference grouping uses that season’s membership. This is not an official conference tiebreak ranking. No playoff/championship probabilities have been fitted.

players.note: Each player has separate passing/rushing/receiving rows: filter role for like-for-like comparisons. Source play-derived totals can differ from official box totals. Missing values are not zero.

games.note: Confirmed results only; opponent may be FCS. Advanced coverage varies by game. Season phase is shown.

cfg.team_note: GP counts all completed opponents, including FCS and postseason. Summary GP (FBS) counts covered FBS-vs-FBS games only; season summary per-game numbers use that smaller sample, not record GP. Game logs can include FCS opponents. Play-derived summaries exclude garbage time; do not interpret their averages as official all-game box averages. Adjusted EPA is retrospective, not a point-in-time forecast. Per-play, drive and opportunity stats have their own denominators.
